fusions.name: Pounce on the Weak
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health: you pounce up to 5 tiles onto it and deal 20 damage plus 1.5 times what your afflictions on it have left to deal, using them up.

fusions.name: Raking Claws
fusions.desc: Rakes gauntlet claws across a cone 2 tiles long, dealing 7 damage with a 30% chance to leave each target [Sundered] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Muffled Steel
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later. Attacking ends it.

fusions.name: Ninth Life
fusions.desc: A killing blow is refused and leaves you at 1 health. Once every 300 seconds.
